```{r setup}
#| include: false

# Loads all the objects/functions built earlier: read_indicator_folder(),
# ward_group_map, build_department_table(), compute_indicators(), etc.
source("tth_indicator_pipeline.R")

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(gt)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)

months_available <- c("Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun")
latest_month <- tail(months_available, 1)   # change if a specific month should "lead" the dashboard

departments <- c(
  "Accident & Emergency", "DEENT", "Internal Medicine",
  "Obstetrics & Gynaecology", "Paediatrics & Child Health",
  "Poly Clinic", "Surgery", "Trauma & Orthopaedics"
)

# Shared gt styling helper so every table on the dashboard - management
# rollup and department pages alike - looks consistent.
style_gt_management <- function(df, rate_cols = NULL) {
  tbl <- gt(df) |>
    tab_options(table.font.names = "Arial", table.font.size = px(13)) |>
    tab_style(
      style = list(cell_fill(color = "#0E5A5A"), cell_text(color = "white", weight = "bold")),
      locations = cells_column_labels()
    ) |>
    opt_row_striping() |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "#E8F6F3"),
      locations = cells_body(rows = seq(1, nrow(df), by = 2))
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "#E8F1F8"),
      locations = cells_body(rows = seq(2, nrow(df), by = 2))
    )

  if (!is.null(rate_cols)) {
    for (col in rate_cols) {
      tbl <- tbl |> data_color(
        columns = all_of(col),
        colors = scales::col_numeric(
          palette = c("#EAF7F5", "#0E5A5A"),
          domain = c(0, 100)
        )
      )
    }
  }
  tbl
}
```

# Management Overview

## Row {height="18%"}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Hospital-wide Bed Occupancy"

hospital_occupancy <- all_indicators_long |>
  inner_join(ward_group_map, by = c("Department","Ward")) |>
  filter(Month == latest_month) |>
  group_by(Indicator) |>
  summarise(Value = sum(Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = Indicator, values_from = Value)

days_this_month <- days_in_month |> filter(Month == latest_month) |> pull(Days)
occ_pct <- round(hospital_occupancy$`Patients Days` /
                  (hospital_occupancy$Beds * days_this_month) * 100, 1)

list(
  icon = "hospital",
  color = if (occ_pct > 85) "danger" else if (occ_pct > 70) "warning" else "success",
  value = paste0(occ_pct, "%")
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Total Admissions"

list(
  icon = "clipboard-plus",
  color = "primary",
  value = format(hospital_occupancy$Admissions, big.mark = ",")
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Total Patient Days"

list(
  icon = "calendar3",
  color = "primary",
  value = format(hospital_occupancy$`Patients Days`, big.mark = ",")
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Hospital-wide Death Rate"

death_rate <- round(hospital_occupancy$Deaths /
                     (hospital_occupancy$Discharges + hospital_occupancy$Deaths) * 100, 1)

list(
  icon = "exclamation-triangle",
  color = if (death_rate > 10) "danger" else "success",
  value = paste0(death_rate, "%")
)
```

## Row {height="42%"}

### Column {width="60%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Bed Occupancy by Department - Trend (Jan-Jun)"

dept_occupancy_trend <- all_indicators_long |>
  inner_join(ward_group_map, by = c("Department","Ward")) |>
  group_by(Department, Indicator, Month) |>
  summarise(Value = sum(Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = Indicator, values_from = Value) |>
  left_join(days_in_month, by = "Month") |>
  mutate(Occupancy_Pct = round(`Patients Days` / (Beds * Days) * 100, 1))

p <- ggplot(dept_occupancy_trend, aes(x = Month, y = Occupancy_Pct,
                                       color = Department, group = Department)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% Bed Occupancy") +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.title = element_blank())

ggplotly(p) |> layout(legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.2))
```

### Column {width="40%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Departments Flagged for Review"
#| padding: 5px

# Simple management tripwire: high occupancy (>85%) or high death
# rate (>10%) in the latest month gets surfaced automatically instead
# of being buried in a full table.
flagged <- dept_occupancy_trend |>
  filter(Month == latest_month) |>
  left_join(
    all_indicators_long |>
      inner_join(ward_group_map, by = c("Department","Ward")) |>
      filter(Month == latest_month) |>
      group_by(Department, Indicator) |>
      summarise(Value = sum(Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
      pivot_wider(names_from = Indicator, values_from = Value) |>
      mutate(Death_Rate_Pct = round(Deaths / (Discharges + Deaths) * 100, 1)) |>
      select(Department, Death_Rate_Pct),
    by = "Department"
  ) |>
  filter(Occupancy_Pct > 85 | Death_Rate_Pct > 10) |>
  select(Department, `% Bed Occupancy` = Occupancy_Pct, `% Death Rate` = Death_Rate_Pct)

if (nrow(flagged) == 0) {
  gt(tibble(Status = "No departments currently flagged")) |>
    tab_options(table.font.names = "Arial")
} else {
  style_gt_management(flagged, rate_cols = c("% Bed Occupancy", "% Death Rate"))
}
```

## Row {height="40%"}

```{r}
#| title: "All Departments - Latest Month Summary"

dept_summary_latest <- dept_occupancy_trend |>
  filter(Month == latest_month) |>
  select(Department, Admissions, Discharges, `Patients Days`, Occupancy_Pct) |>
  arrange(desc(Occupancy_Pct))

style_gt_management(dept_summary_latest, rate_cols = "Occupancy_Pct")
```

# Surgery

## Row {height="45%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Table 12 - Surgery Ward Indicators"

table12_surgery <- build_department_table(all_indicators_long, "Surgery", latest_month)

style_management_table(
  table12_surgery,
  title = paste("Surgery Ward Indicators -", latest_month, "2026"),
  rate_rows = c("% Bed Occupancy", "% Death Rate", "Average Daily Bed Occupancy")
)
```

## Row {height="55%"}

### Column {width="50%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Occupancy by Subspecialty - Trend"

surg_trend <- all_indicators_long |>
  inner_join(ward_group_map |> filter(Department == "Surgery"), by = "Ward") |>
  group_by(Subspecialty, Indicator, Month) |>
  summarise(Value = sum(Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = Indicator, values_from = Value) |>
  left_join(days_in_month, by = "Month") |>
  mutate(Occupancy_Pct = round(`Patients Days` / (Beds * Days) * 100, 1))

p2 <- ggplot(surg_trend, aes(x = Month, y = Occupancy_Pct,
                              color = Subspecialty, group = Subspecialty)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) + geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% Bed Occupancy") +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.title = element_blank())

ggplotly(p2) |> layout(legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.3))
```

### Column {width="50%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Average Length of Stay by Subspecialty - Trend"

p3 <- ggplot(surg_trend |> mutate(Total_Discharged = Discharges + coalesce(Deaths, 0),
                                    ALOS = round(`Patients Days` / Total_Discharged, 1)),
             aes(x = Month, y = ALOS, color = Subspecialty, group = Subspecialty)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) + geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Average Length of Stay (days)") +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.title = element_blank())

ggplotly(p3) |> layout(legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.3))
```
